title: Potent and selective α-glucosidase inhibition by coumarin–triazole conjugates: design, in vivo evaluation, and computational insights
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29844-29866
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01115B, Paper

Mahdis Sadeghi Moghadam, Bahareh Bayati, Fariba Peytam, Maryam Norouzbahari, Hayrettin Ozan Gülcan, Somayeh Mojtabavi, Fahimeh Ghasemi, Seyed Esmaeil Sadat-Ebrahimi, Maliheh Barazandeh Tehrani, Vahid Sheibani, Loghman Firoozpour, Alireza Foroumadi
Compound 12q emerged as the most potent inhibitor (IC50 = 1.0 µM) and showed high selectivity toward α-glucosidase over α-amylase. The in silico studies further confirmed the activity. In vivo studies demonstrated that 12q outperformed acarbose.
